record.question: Under the Employment Exchanges (Compulsory Notification of Vacancies) Act, 1959 - If an employer fails to notify the employment exchanges prescribed for the purpose any vacancy in contravention
options: he shall be punished with fine up to three hundred rupees
he shall be punished with fine up to five hundred rupees
he shall be punished with fine up to three hundred rupees which can extend to one thousand rupees
he shall be punished with fine up to five hundred rupees which can extend to one thousand rupees
record.explanation: Failure to notify a vacancy attracts a fine up to Rs. 500 extendable to Rs. 1000.
